dedupe_keys.name: kherson dam break flood mapping with ml4floods

description: This ML4Floods notebook documents satellite flood mapping after the June 2023 dam break between Nova Kakhovka and Kherson, Ukraine. It queries imagery from 31 May to 12 June and applies a cloud-aware model to Sentinel-2 images from 3 and 8 June and Landsat 9 from 9 June. Outputs include mapped water classes, vectorised extents and a combined pre-event and post-event flood product. The notebook and pretrained models permit noncommercial reuse under CC-BY-NC-4.0; package code uses LGPL-3.0. A limitation is that cloud and acquisition timing affect observed extent, and the demonstration supplies neither a flood-depth estimate nor independent accuracy measurements for this event. Reproduction requires the documented external imagery and computing services. The case provides reusable observation-processing steps for evaluating dam-break infrastructure simulations, linked to platform-ml4floods and model-delft3d-fm. Its documented outcome is a multi-sensor flood map, without a claimed operational emergency-response benefit. Only the rendered notebook was inspected; no imagery or models were downloaded.
licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 notebook and pretrained models; LGPL-3.0 package software
